entry.author: RNZ
entry.summary:
Five people have been arrested and more than a million cigarettes seized as part of the effort to crack down on the black market tobacco trade | Subscribe: https://www.youtube.com/RNZVideo?
 
RNZ has been investigating the illicit cigarette trade in Auckland over the past three months, and have identified a number of shops selling the product at prices well below the retail value.
 
Speaking in Auckland on Wednesday, the illicit tobacco Action Group, formed earlier this year, said they had conducted their first joint operation since the group was established in May. The group, made up of Police, Customs, and Health officials, searched 21 properties, including eight stores and six homes in Auckland, Rotorua, and Waikato.
 
Full story: https://www.rnz.co.nz/news/crime-and-justice/650455/more-than-a-million-cigarettes-seized-five-arrested-in-black-market-crackdown
